ACIA — MISSION 07 — AVIATION OPERATIONS

Air Traffic Communication

Listen. Interpret. Communicate. Adapt.

CAPTAIN ACIA

Welcome to Mission 7.

You're about to experience how communication, attention and decision-making come together in an airport environment. You'll receive messages from aircraft, monitor changing information and respond to different situations.

You don't need aviation experience. Listen carefully, communicate clearly and ask questions whenever something doesn't make sense.

COMMUNICATION SETUP

For the best experience, use headphones. Voice is optional — you can type all responses.

MISSION COMPLETE — REFLECTION

Before we close, take a moment to reflect on what you experienced.

Communication in Context

What did you notice about how information was exchanged in these scenarios? What made some communications clearer or more difficult than others?

Handling Uncertainty

At some points, information seemed unclear, incomplete or conflicting. What was your instinct when that happened?

Setting Priorities

In the later scenarios, several things were happening at the same time. How did you decide what to respond to first or focus on most?
